text:
Each person eats \(0.2\text{ kg}\) per meal.  
Meals with rice each day: lunch + dinner = 2 meals.  

Daily consumption:
\[
5\text{ people}\times0.2\text{ kg/meal}\times2\text{ meals/day}=2\text{ kg/day}.
\]

Duration of a 42 kg bag:
\[
\frac{42\text{ kg}}{2\text{ kg/day}} = 21\text{ days}.
\]

Convert days to weeks:
\[
\frac{21\text{ days}}{7\text{ days/week}} = 3\text{ weeks}.
\]

**Final answer: 3**
